Mckinley Capital Management Increases Holding in Baidu (BIDU); Force Capital Management Lifted Its Apple (AAPL) Holding 
April 23, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Robert Jaffe increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 21.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Force Capital Management Llc bought 5,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund run by Robert Jaffe held 32,145 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.44 million, up from 26,445 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Force Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $840.87 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 4.10% or $7.08   $165.72. About 60.26M shares traded or 55.95% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Robert B. Gillam increased its stake in Baidu Inc (BIDU) by 245.26% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gillam held 11,756 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.75 million, up from 3,405 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
